title: Versions
description: A short note on a warm white ground with its twelve earlier saves stacked behind it, receding in real perspective into a soft haze. Drag or scroll and you fly back through them: the front card swells and dissolves past you, the next save comes forward and settles on a soft spring with a small tick, and only the card at the front marks what that save changed, what it wrote inked in from the caret as a serif correction, the way a proofreader marks a page, and a fine red caret where words were taken out. A hairline timeline at the edge swells around the current save and names when it was made.
intent: After macOS Time Machine's receding stack of window versions (https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/restore-files-mh11422/mac) and the Time Machine stack pattern on devouringdetails.com (https://devouringdetails.com): versions recede into depth and scrolling brings older states forward, here applied to the saves of one document with the diff shown only where you are looking.
